evidence_classes.derived: Fits, distances, domain angles and stationary-current calculations from stated software rules.
evidence_classes.modelled: Bovine monomer coordinates; c8 ring required by player. Structure is not a measured rotation trajectory.
evidence_classes.illustrative: Membrane, moving particles, interpolated shapes, colors and display time.

clocks: Demonstration seconds, not a fitted enzymatic rate. Classic spin is radians/second; normalize by 2*pi.
limitations: Classic ATP counts occupied-site formation; candidate counts release sectors; event phase/occupancy comparison pending.
No variable ring stoichiometry, protonmotive-force integration, thermodynamic free-energy calculation or ATP transport cost.
Brownian paths, particle numbers, membrane, beta interpolation and timings are teaching choices.

literature.title: Structure of the dimeric ATP synthase from bovine mitochondria.
literature.scope: Primary deposited-structure publication; does not validate chosen kinetic rates.
